<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>Solidworks BOM Conversion Tool</title>

    <!-- Tailwind CSS -->
    <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>
    <script>
        /* Tailwind config must live in a <script> (not <style>) to register the brand colours. */
        tailwind.config = { theme: { extend: { colors: { primary: '#2d9cdb', 'primary-dark': '#1e7bb4' } } } };
    </script>

    <!-- Google Fonts - Inter -->
    <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@300;400;500;600;700;800;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

    <!-- Shared Fishbowl BI lib (Settings layer + Common formatting/debug helpers).
         Inlined by Fishbowl from the saved script named "fb-lib". Source of truth
         lives at scripts/fb-lib.js. Uses FBLib.Common + FBLib.Settings only. -->
    <script>
        {% Script fb-lib %}
    </script>

    <style>
        /* ============================================
           BASE + TOKENS
           ============================================ */
        :root {
            --color-primary: #2d9cdb;
            --color-primary-dark: #1e7bb4;
        }
        * { box-sizing: border-box; }
        html, body { margin: 0; padding: 0; }
        body {
            font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
            font-size: 13px;
            color: #1e293b;
            background: #f8fafc;
        }

        /* ============================================
           HEADER BAR
           ============================================ */
        header {
            position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 50;
            background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
            box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.04);
            display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
            padding: 0 20px; height: 56px;
        }
        header h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; margin: 0; line-height: 1.15; }
        #statusLine { font-size: 12px; color: #94a3b8; line-height: 1.15; margin: 2px 0 0; }
        .hdr-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .hdr-btn {
            display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
            font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fff;
            color: #475569; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; white-space: nowrap; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .hdr-btn:hover { background: #f8fafc; border-color: #cbd5e1; }
        .hdr-btn svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; flex-shrink: 0; }
        .hdr-btn-icon { padding: 7px; }

        /* ============================================
           PAGE WRAP + CARDS
           ============================================ */
        .container { max-width: 1400px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 16px 20px 60px; }
        .card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); margin-bottom: 16px; }

        h1 { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; }
        h2 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; }
        h3 { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; }
        h4 { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        h5 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; }
        h6 { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1e293b; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .subtitle { font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; margin-bottom: 12px; }

        /* ============================================
           BUTTONS
           ============================================ */
        .btn {
            display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
            padding: 7px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600;
            border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; color: #334155;
            border-radius: 7px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s;
            text-decoration: none; line-height: 1.4; font-family: inherit;
        }
        .btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }
        .btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); border-color: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .btn-outline-primary { color: var(--color-primary); border-color: #cbd5e1; background: #fff; }
        .btn-outline-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary); border-color: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; }
        .btn-success { background: #10b981; color: #fff; border-color: #10b981; }
        .btn-success:hover { background: #059669; border-color: #059669; }
        .btn-outline-success { color: #059669; border-color: #cbd5e1; background: #fff; }
        .btn-outline-success:hover { background: #10b981; border-color: #10b981; color: #fff; }
        .btn-sm { padding: 4px 9px; font-size: 11px; border-radius: 6px; }
        .btn-lg { padding: 8px 14px; font-size: 13px; }
        .btn-close { background: transparent; border: none; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1; opacity: 0.6; cursor: pointer; padding: 0; color: inherit; }
        .btn-close:hover { opacity: 1; }

        /* ============================================
           FORM CONTROLS
           ============================================ */
        input[type="text"], input[type="file"], input[type="date"], input[type="number"],
        select, .form-control, .form-select {
            padding: 7px 9px; font-size: 13px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px;
            color: #1e293b; background: #fff; font-family: inherit;
        }
        input:focus, select:focus, .form-control:focus, .form-select:focus {
            outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,0.15);
        }
        input[type="checkbox"] { cursor: pointer; width: auto; }
        label { font-size: 12px; color: #334155; font-weight: 500; }
        .form-select-sm, .form-control-sm { padding: 5px 8px; font-size: 12px; }

        /* ============================================
           ALERTS
           ============================================ */
        .alert { border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid; font-size: 12px; padding: 9px 12px; margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .alert-info { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af; }
        .alert-warning { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #fcd34d; color: #92400e; }
        .alert-danger { background: #fee2e2; border-color: #fca5a5; color: #991b1b; }
        .alert-success { background: #d1fae5; border-color: #6ee7b7; color: #065f46; }

        /* ============================================
           PROGRESS
           ============================================ */
        .progress-section { margin-bottom: 12px; }
        .progress { background: #e2e8f0; border-radius: 999px; height: 7px; overflow: hidden; }
        .progress-bar { background: var(--color-primary); height: 100%; transition: width 0.3s ease; }
        .progress-bar-striped { background-image: linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 25%,transparent 25%,transparent 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 50%,rgba(255,255,255,.2) 75%,transparent 75%,transparent); background-size: 1rem 1rem; }
        .progress-bar-animated { animation: progress-bar-stripes 1s linear infinite; }
        @keyframes progress-bar-stripes { 0% { background-position: 1rem 0; } 100% { background-position: 0 0; } }

        /* ============================================
           ACCORDION
           ============================================ */
        .accordion { margin-bottom: 0; }
        .accordion-item { border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.03); }
        .accordion-header { margin: 0; }
        .accordion-button {
            display: block; width: 100%; background: #f8fafc; color: #1e293b;
            font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 10px 14px; border: none; text-align: left; cursor: pointer;
        }
        .accordion-button:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .accordion-button:not(.collapsed) { background: #eff6ff; color: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        /* NB: do NOT use the class name "collapse" here — it collides with the
           Tailwind CDN's `collapse` utility (visibility: collapse), which hides
           the panel even when display is block. Key off .show only. */
        .accordion-collapse { overflow: hidden; }
        .accordion-collapse.show { display: block; }
        .accordion-collapse:not(.show) { display: none; }
        .accordion-body { padding: 0; }

        /* ============================================
           TABLES
           ============================================ */
        .results-table-container { max-height: 600px; overflow: auto; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fff; }
        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; }
        .data-table, .table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: 12.5px; }
        th, .data-table th, .table thead th {
            background: #f8fafc; padding: 8px 10px; text-align: left;
            font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; color: #475569;
            text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em;
            border-bottom: 2px solid #e2e8f0; position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 10; white-space: nowrap;
        }
        td, .data-table td, .table td { padding: 6px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eef2f7; color: #334155; font-size: 12.5px; }
        tbody tr:hover, .data-table tbody tr:hover, .table tbody tr:hover, .table-hover tbody tr:hover { background: #f8fafc; }
        .table-sm td, .table-sm th { padding: 5px 8px; }

        /* BOM tree header rows */
        .bom-header-row { font-weight: 600; }
        .bom-header-row:hover { filter: brightness(0.98); }

        /* ============================================
           BADGES
           ============================================ */
        .badge { display: inline-block; font-weight: 600; padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 10px; line-height: 1.5; vertical-align: baseline; white-space: nowrap; }
        .bg-primary { background: var(--color-primary) !important; color: #fff !important; }
        .bg-success { background: #10b981 !important; color: #fff !important; }
        .bg-info { background: #3b82f6 !important; color: #fff !important; }
        .bg-warning { background: #f59e0b !important; color: #fff !important; }
        .bg-danger { background: #ef4444 !important; color: #fff !important; }
        .bg-dark { background: #1e293b !important; color: #fff !important; }

        /* ============================================
           TEXT UTILITIES
           ============================================ */
        .text-muted { color: #64748b; }
        .text-primary { color: var(--color-primary); }
        .text-success { color: #10b981; }
        .text-danger { color: #ef4444; }
        .text-warning { color: #f59e0b; }
        .text-white { color: #fff; }
        .fw-bold { font-weight: 700; }
        .text-center { text-align: center; }
        .d-block { display: block; }

        /* ============================================
           SCROLLBAR
           ============================================ */
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar, .results-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-track, .results-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: #f1f5f9; border-radius: 4px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb, .results-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: #cbd5e1; border-radius: 4px; }
        .custom-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover, .results-table-container::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: #94a3b8; }

        /* ============================================
           UPLOAD SECTION
           ============================================ */
        .upload-section {
            padding: 22px; background: #fff; border: 2px dashed #cbd5e1; border-radius: 10px;
            text-align: center; margin-bottom: 16px; transition: all 0.2s ease;
        }
        .upload-section:hover { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: #f8fafc; }
        .upload-section.dragover { border-color: #10b981; background: #d1fae5; border-style: solid; }
        .upload-section h3 { margin: 0 0 6px 0; }
        .upload-section p { margin: 4px 0; font-size: 12px; color: #64748b; }

        /* ============================================
           SUMMARY STATS
           ============================================ */
        .summary-stats { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; }
        .stat-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 5px 11px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; border: 1px solid; line-height: 1.4; }
        .stat-badge.total { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #bfdbfe; color: #1e40af; }
        .stat-badge.parts { background: #eff6ff; border-color: #93c5fd; color: #1e40af; }
        .stat-badge.boms { background: #f1f5f9; border-color: #cbd5e1; color: #475569; }
        .stat-badge.new-parts { background: #d1fae5; border-color: #6ee7b7; color: #065f46; }
        .stat-badge.warning { background: #fef3c7; border-color: #fcd34d; color: #92400e; }
        .stat-badge.error { background: #fee2e2; border-color: #fca5a5; color: #991b1b; }
        .stat-number { font-weight: 800; }
        .stat-label { opacity: 0.85; }

        /* ============================================
           CONFIG GROUPS (settings panel)
           ============================================ */
        .config-group { margin-bottom: 14px; padding: 12px; background: #f8fafc; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
        .config-group h5 { color: #1e293b; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 8px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.03em; }
        .config-item { margin-bottom: 10px; }
        .config-item label { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 4px; }
        .config-item .form-select, .config-item .form-control { width: 100%; }
        .form-check { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
        .form-check-input { margin: 0; }
        .form-check-label { font-size: 12px; color: #334155; font-weight: 500; }

        /* ============================================
           INFO BOXES (help panel)
           ============================================ */
        .info-box { padding: 11px 12px; background: #eff6ff; border-left: 3px solid var(--color-primary); border-radius: 7px; margin-bottom: 12px; font-size: 12px; color: #334155; }
        .info-box ul { margin-bottom: 0; padding-left: 18px; }
        .info-box li { margin-bottom: 4px; }
        .info-box h6 { font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
        .info-box p { margin: 4px 0; }

        /* ============================================
           FIELD MAPPING
           ============================================ */
        .mapping-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 45% 10% 45%; align-items: center; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; padding: 7px; background: #fff; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #e2e8f0; }
        .mapping-label { font-weight: 500; color: #1e293b; font-size: 12px; }
        .mapping-arrow { color: var(--color-primary); font-size: 14px; text-align: center; }
        .mapping-select, select.mapping-select { padding: 6px 8px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 12px; width: 100%; background: #fff; color: #1e293b; }
        .mapping-select:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--color-primary); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,156,219,0.15); }
        .required-field::after { content: " *"; color: #ef4444; }
        select.is-invalid { border-color: #ef4444; }

        /* ============================================
           LAYOUT UTILITIES
           ============================================ */
        .hidden { display: none !important; }
        .mb-3 { margin-bottom: 12px; } .mb-2 { margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .mt-1 { margin-top: 4px; } .mt-2 { margin-top: 8px; } .mt-3 { margin-top: 12px; } .mt-4 { margin-top: 16px; }
        .ms-2 { margin-left: 8px; } .me-2 { margin-right: 8px; }
        .p-0 { padding: 0; } .p-2 { padding: 8px; }
        .d-flex { display: flex; } .d-grid { display: grid; }
        .gap-2 { gap: 8px; }
        .justify-content-center { justify-content: center; }
        .justify-content-between { justify-content: space-between; }
        .align-items-center { align-items: center; }
        .flex-wrap { flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .export-section { margin-bottom: 16px; }

        /* ============================================
           TOASTS (house slide-in)
           ============================================ */
        .toast-container { position: fixed; bottom: 1rem; right: 1rem; top: 1rem; z-index: 9999; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; overflow-y: auto; pointer-events: none; }
        .toast-container .toast { pointer-events: auto; }
        .toast {
            min-width: 280px; max-width: 380px; padding: 12px 14px; background: #fff; border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: 0 10px 25px -5px rgba(0,0,0,0.2); border-left: 4px solid #3b82f6;
            display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; animation: toastSlideIn 0.25s ease-out;
            transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
        }
        .toast.success { border-left-color: #10b981; }
        .toast.error   { border-left-color: #ef4444; }
        .toast.warn    { border-left-color: #f59e0b; }
        .toast.info    { border-left-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .toast .toast-icon { font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.3; }
        .toast.success .toast-icon { color: #10b981; }
        .toast.error .toast-icon { color: #ef4444; }
        .toast.warn .toast-icon { color: #f59e0b; }
        .toast.info .toast-icon { color: var(--color-primary); }
        /* min-width:0 + break-word let long unbreakable tokens (FK names, column
           lists) wrap instead of overflowing and shoving the close button off-screen.
           max-height keeps a huge error scrollable rather than taller than the viewport. */
        .toast .toast-msg { font-size: 12.5px; color: #334155; font-weight: 500; flex: 1; min-width: 0; line-height: 1.4; word-break: break-word; overflow-wrap: anywhere; max-height: 40vh; overflow-y: auto; }
        .toast .toast-x { background: none; border: none; color: #94a3b8; cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; padding: 2px 4px; margin: -2px -4px 0 0; flex-shrink: 0; align-self: flex-start; }
        .toast .toast-x:hover { color: #475569; }
        @keyframes toastSlideIn { from { transform: translateX(400px); opacity: 0; } to { transform: translateX(0); opacity: 1; } }

        /* ============================================
           SLIDE-IN PANELS (settings + help)
           ============================================ */
        .panel-overlay { position: fixed; inset: 0; background: rgba(0,0,0,0.45); z-index: 1001; display: none; justify-content: flex-end; }
        .panel-overlay.open { display: flex; }
        .panel { background: #f8fafc; width: 420px; max-width: 95vw; height: 100%; overflow-y: auto; box-shadow: -2px 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.25); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .panel .ds-header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 13px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; }
        .panel .ds-header h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 15px; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; }
        .panel .ds-close { background: transparent; border: none; font-size: 24px; cursor: pointer; color: #fff; line-height: 1; opacity: 0.9; }
        .panel .ds-close:hover { opacity: 1; }
        .panel .ds-body { padding: 16px 18px; flex: 1; }
        .panel .ds-label { display: block; font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: #475569; margin-bottom: 8px; }
        .panel .ds-footer { padding: 12px 18px; border-top: 1px solid #e2e8f0; background: #fff; display: flex; gap: 8px; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
        .panel .ds-btn { padding: 7px 13px; font-size: 12px; border-radius: 7px; border: 1px solid #cbd5e1; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600; color: #334155; }
        .panel .ds-btn:hover { background: #f1f5f9; }
        .panel .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: #fff; border-color: var(--color-primary); }
        .panel .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-primary-dark); }
        .panel .ds-admin { border-top: 1px dashed #cbd5e1; padding-top: 14px; margin-top: 6px; }
        .panel .ds-btn-admin { display: block; width: 100%; margin-bottom: 6px; background: #fef3c7; border-color: #f59e0b; color: #7c2d12; }
        .panel .ds-lock-badge { background: #fef3c7; color: #92400e; border: 1px solid #f59e0b; padding: 7px 10px; border-radius: 7px; font-size: 12px; margin-bottom: 14px; }

        /* ============================================
           DEBUG CONSOLE (shown only when BI_SHOW_DEBUG=true)
           ============================================ */
        #debugConsole { display: none; }
        #debugConsole .dc-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; background: #0f172a; padding: 10px 14px; border-radius: 10px 10px 0 0; }
        #debugConsole .dc-head h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 12px; color: #e2e8f0; font-weight: 600; }
        #debugLog { background: #0f172a; border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px; padding: 12px; max-height: 280px; overflow-y: auto; font-family: ui-monospace, 'Courier New', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: #e2e8f0; white-space: pre-wrap; line-height: 1.5; }
        .mini-btn { padding: 4px 9px; font-size: 11px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid #334155; background: #1e293b; color: #cbd5e1; cursor: pointer; font-family: inherit; }
        .mini-btn:hover { background: #334155; }

        /* ============================================
           SPINNER
           ============================================ */
        @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
        .spin { animation: spin 0.8s linear infinite; }
    </style>
</head>

<body>
    <!-- ============================================
         HEADER
         ============================================ -->
    <header>
        <div>
            <h1>Solidworks BOM Converter</h1>
            <p id="statusLine">Upload a Solidworks BOM CSV to begin.</p>
        </div>
        <div class="hdr-actions">
            <button class="hdr-btn" type="button" onclick="HelpPanel.open()" title="How to use this tool">
                <svg fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10"/><path d="M9.09 9a3 3 0 015.83 1c0 2-3 3-3 3"/><line x1="12" y1="17" x2="12.01" y2="17"/></svg>
                Help

        // ============================================================
        // CSV HEADER + LEVEL-COLUMN DETECTION
        //
        // Two export shapes have to be tolerated:
        //   * a report title / "generated on" banner row (or several) sitting
        //     ABOVE the real column-header row - these must be found and
        //     skipped, both for column mapping and for the data pass;
        //   * a hierarchy spread across SEVERAL columns (one per indenture
        //     level) instead of a single dotted "1.1.2" cell.
        // ============================================================

        // Words that identify a column-header row. Deliberately generous - it is
        // scoring, not matching, that decides which row wins.
        const HEADER_KEYWORDS = [
            'level', 'indenture', 'indent', 'stage', 'item no', 'line',
            'part number', 'partnumber', 'part no', 'part #', 'p/n', 'number',
            'description', 'desc', 'name', 'details',
            'quantity', 'qty', 'uom', 'unit of measure', 'u/m',
            'rev', 'revision', 'state', 'status',
            'vendor', 'supplier', 'manufacturer', 'mfg',
            'cost', 'price', 'currency', 'moq',
            'upc', 'weight', 'width', 'height', 'length', 'designator', 'substitute'
        ];

        // Safe trimmed read of one cell.
        function _cell(row, i) {
            const v = row ? row[i] : '';
            return String(v === undefined || v === null ? '' : v).trim();
        }

        // Score one parsed row on how much it looks like a column-header row.
        function scoreHeaderRow(cells) {
            let filled = 0, kw = 0;
            (cells || []).forEach(function (c) {
                const v = String(c === undefined || c === null ? '' : c).toLowerCase().trim();
                if (!v) return;
                filled++;
                for (let i = 0; i < HEADER_KEYWORDS.length; i++) {
                    if (v.indexOf(HEADER_KEYWORDS[i]) !== -1) { kw++; break; }
                }
            });
            return { filled: filled, kw: kw, score: kw * 10 + filled };
        }

        // Pick the column-header row out of the first few rows of the file. A banner
        // row ("Bill of Materials Report", "Generated on: ...") has only a couple of
        // filled cells and no field names, so it always loses to the real header.
        function detectHeaderRow(rows) {
            const scan = Math.min(rows.length, 10);
            let bestIdx = 0, bestScore = -Infinity;
            for (let i = 0; i < scan; i++) {
                const s = scoreHeaderRow(rows[i]);
                // Needs at least two recognisable field names to be a header at all.
                const eff = s.kw >= 2 ? s.score : s.score - 1000;
                if (eff > bestScore) { bestScore = eff; bestIdx = i; }   // strict > keeps the earliest on a tie
            }
            return bestIdx;
        }

        // Turn raw header cells into labels that are unique and never blank, so every
        // column stays addressable by name in the mapping dropdowns. Headers that are
        // already clean and unique come back untouched, which keeps saved mappings valid.
        function buildColumnLabels(cells) {
            const seen = {};
            return (cells || []).map(function (raw, i) {
                let label = String(raw === undefined || raw === null ? '' : raw).trim();
                if (!label) label = '(Column ' + (i + 1) + ')';
                const key = label.toLowerCase();
                seen[key] = (seen[key] || 0) + 1;
                return seen[key] > 1 ? label + ' (' + seen[key] + ')' : label;
            });
        }

        // Locate the level column and, when the header row leaves the columns after it
        // unnamed, the span of columns the indent occupies.
        function detectLevelSpan(cells) {
            let start = -1;
            for (let i = 0; i < (cells || []).length; i++) {
                const v = _cell(cells, i).toLowerCase();
                if (!v) continue;
                if (/\b(indenture|level|lvl|indent)\b/.test(v)) { start = i; break; }
            }
            if (start < 0) return null;
            let end = start;
            while (end + 1 < cells.length && _cell(cells, end + 1) === '') end++;
            return { start: start, end: end };
        }

        // Depth of a row in indent mode: the position of the RIGHT-MOST filled cell
        // inside the level span. That handles both exports that fill only the row's own
        // level and exports that also fill every ancestor column. -1 = no level at all.
        function indentDepth(row, startIdx, endIdx) {
            let d = -1;
            for (let i = startIdx; i <= endIdx; i++) {
                if (_cell(row, i) !== '') d = i - startIdx;
            }
            return d;
        }

        // Sequential depth -> dotted level ("1", "1.1", "1.1.2", "1.2", "2"...). Fed the
        // rows in file order it reproduces the numbering the Fishbowl BOM import expects.
        function makeLevelSequencer() {
            const stack = [];
            let clamped = 0;
            const seq = function (depth) {
                // A row jumping more than one level deeper than its predecessor would
                // have no parent BOM, so pull it back to the deepest valid depth.
                if (depth > stack.length) { clamped++; depth = stack.length; }
                if (depth < stack.length) stack.length = depth + 1;
                while (stack.length < depth + 1) stack.push(0);
                stack[depth] = (stack[depth] || 0) + 1;
                return stack.slice(0, depth + 1).join('.');
            };
            seq.clampedCount = function () { return clamped; };
            return seq;
        }

        // Decide from the header row (confirmed against the data) whether the hierarchy
        // is one dotted column or spread across several indent columns. The user can
        // always override the result in the field-mapping dialog.
        function autoDetectLevelStyle() {
            // A format the user chose explicitly - in the mapping dialog, or via an
            // imported mapping/configuration file - wins over detection, provided the
            // columns it names are still present in this CSV.
            const prior = levelConfig || {};
            const priorExplicit = prior.autoDetected === false && prior.style && prior.style !== 'dotted';

            levelConfig = { style: 'dotted', endCol: null, autoDetected: false };

            if (priorExplicit &&
                (prior.style !== 'indent' || (prior.endCol && solidworksColumns.indexOf(prior.endCol) !== -1))) {
                levelConfig = { style: prior.style, endCol: prior.endCol || null, autoDetected: false };
                debugLog('info', 'Keeping the previously chosen BOM level format: ' + prior.style);
                return;
            }

            const span = detectLevelSpan(csvRawHeaders);
            if (!span || span.end <= span.start) return;

            // A real indent puts values in more than just the first column of the span,
            // and never uses dotted values.
            let usesOtherCols = false, anyDotted = false;
            for (let r = 0; r < csvDataRows.length; r++) {
                for (let i = span.start; i <= span.end; i++) {
                    const v = _cell(csvDataRows[r], i);
                    if (!v) continue;
                    if (i > span.start) usesOtherCols = true;
                    if (v.indexOf('.') !== -1) anyDotted = true;
                }
            }
            if (!usesOtherCols || anyDotted) return;

            levelConfig = { style: 'indent', endCol: solidworksColumns[span.end], autoDetected: true };
            debugLog('success', 'Multi-column BOM level detected: "' + solidworksColumns[span.start] +
                '" through "' + solidworksColumns[span.end] + '" (' + (span.end - span.start + 1) + ' columns)');
        }

        // Persistent warning strip above the results (toasts are easy to miss).

        // Parse Solidworks CSV - ONLY extract headers
        function parseSolidworksCSV(csvContent) {
            debugLog('info', 'Loading Solidworks BOM CSV...');
            showMessage('Loading Solidworks BOM...', 'info');

            try {
                // Store raw content for later processing
                rawCSVContent = csvContent;

                // Clear the previous file's warnings straight away - re-mapping can
                // delay the next analysis, and a stale banner would describe the
                // wrong sheet in the meantime.
                lastParseWarnings = { skippedNoPart: 0, skippedNoLevel: 0, clamped: 0, blankUom: 0 };
                uomColumnMapped = true;
                setWarningBanner([]);

                // Parse CSV into rows
                const lines = csvContent.split('\n').map(line => line.trim()).filter(line => line.length > 0);
                debugLog('info', `Total lines in CSV: ${lines.length}`);

                if (lines.length < 2) {
                    debugLog('error', 'CSV file is empty or has no data rows');
                    showMessage('CSV file is empty or invalid', 'danger');
                    return;
                }

                const allRows = lines.map(parseCSVLine);

                // Some exports put a report title / "generated on" banner above the real
                // column headings, so find the header row instead of assuming row 1.
                const headerIdx = detectHeaderRow(allRows);
                csvPreambleRows = headerIdx;
                csvRawHeaders = allRows[headerIdx];
                csvDataRows = allRows.slice(headerIdx + 1);

                if (csvDataRows.length === 0) {
                    debugLog('error', 'No data rows found below the detected header row');
                    showMessage('No data rows found below the column headings', 'danger');
                    return;
                }

                // Blank and duplicated header cells get stable, unique labels so every
                // column stays addressable by name in the mapping dropdowns.
                const headers = buildColumnLabels(csvRawHeaders);
                solidworksColumns = headers;
                debugLog('success', `Detected ${headers.length} columns in Solidworks CSV`, headers);
                if (headerIdx > 0) {
                    debugLog('info', `Ignored ${headerIdx} pre-header row(s) above the column headings`);
                }

                // Work out how the hierarchy is encoded before the mapping dialog opens.

                const preambleNote = headerIdx > 0 ? ` (${headerIdx} pre-header row(s) ignored)` : '';

                        col => col && !headers.includes(col)
                    );

                    if (invalidMappings.length === 0) {
                        // Existing mappings are valid - use them

                        }
                    } else {

                        debugLog('warning', `Pre-loaded mappings have ${invalidMappings.length} invalid columns - need to remap`);
                        showMessage('Loaded mappings don\'t match CSV columns - please configure field mappings', 'warning');
                        fieldMappings = {}; // Clear invalid mappings
                        loadSavedMappings(); // Try saved settings as fallback
                    }
                } else {
                    // No pre-loaded mappings - try to load saved mappings from user settings
                    loadSavedMappings();
                }

            } catch (error) {
                debugLog('error', 'Error loading Solidworks CSV', error.toString());
                showMessage('Error loading CSV: ' + error.message, 'danger');
            }
        }

        // Process BOM Data AFTER mappings are configured
        async function processBOMData() {
            debugLog('info', 'Processing BOM data with configured mappings...');

            if (!rawCSVContent) {
                showMessage('No CSV file loaded', 'danger');
                return;
            }

            // Costs are re-read for this run (a part created since the last run, or a
            // changed vendor cost, must not be served from the previous pass's cache).
            partCostCache = new Map();

            // Progress spinner while the (synchronous) parse + structure analysis runs.
            showProgress('Processing BOM structure…', 40, true);
            await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 0); });

            try {
                // Rows were parsed - and any pre-header banner rows dropped - at load time.
                const dataRows = csvDataRows || [];

                // Get mapped column names from the new simplified structure
                const levelCol = fieldMappings['Level'];
                const partCol = fieldMappings['Number'];
                const descCol = fieldMappings['Description'];
                const detailsCol = fieldMappings['Details'];
                const revisionCol = fieldMappings['Revision'];
                const standardCostCol = fieldMappings['Standard Cost'];
                const qtyCol = fieldMappings['Quantity'];
                const upcCol = fieldMappings['UPC'];
                const uomCol = fieldMappings['UOM'];
                const weightCol = fieldMappings['Weight'];
                const widthCol = fieldMappings['Width'];
                const heightCol = fieldMappings['Height'];
                const lengthCol = fieldMappings['Length'];
                const vendorCol = fieldMappings['Vendor'];
                const vendorNumberCol = fieldMappings['Vendor Number'];
                const vendorCostCol = fieldMappings['Vendor Cost'];

                debugLog('info', 'Using mapped columns', fieldMappings);

                // Find column indices
                const levelIndex = levelCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(levelCol) : -1;
                const partNumIndex = partCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(partCol) : -1;
                const descIndex = descCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(descCol) : -1;
                const detailsIndex = detailsCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(detailsCol) : -1;
                const revisionIndex = revisionCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(revisionCol) : -1;
                const costIndex = standardCostCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(standardCostCol) : -1;
                const qtyIndex = qtyCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(qtyCol) : -1;
                const upcIndex = upcCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(upcCol) : -1;
                const uomIndex = uomCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(uomCol) : -1;
                const weightIndex = weightCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(weightCol) : -1;
                const widthIndex = widthCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(widthCol) : -1;
                const heightIndex = heightCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(heightCol) : -1;
                const lengthIndex = lengthCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(lengthCol) : -1;
                const vendorIndex = vendorCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(vendorCol) : -1;
                const vendorNumIndex = vendorNumberCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(vendorNumberCol) : -1;
                const vendorCostIndex = vendorCostCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(vendorCostCol) : -1;

                // How the hierarchy is encoded: dotted (default), multi-column indent,
                // or a bare depth number. Indent needs a valid span or it can't be used.
                let levelStyle = levelConfig.style || 'dotted';
                const levelEndIndex = levelConfig.endCol ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(levelConfig.endCol) : -1;
                if (levelStyle === 'indent' && (levelIndex < 0 || levelEndIndex <= levelIndex)) {
                    debugLog('warning', 'Multi-column level span is invalid - falling back to dotted levels');
                    levelStyle = 'dotted';
                }
                uomColumnMapped = uomIndex >= 0;

                // Parse data rows
                const bomItems = [];
                const nextLevel = makeLevelSequencer();
                let skippedNoPart = 0, skippedNoLevel = 0, numericBase = null;

                for (let i = 0; i < dataRows.length; i++) {
                    const row = dataRows[i];
                    if (!row || row.length === 0) continue;

                    // Trailing total/spacer rows carry no part number - drop them before
                    // the level sequencer runs so they can't consume a level ordinal.
                    if (partNumIndex >= 0 && _cell(row, partNumIndex) === '') { skippedNoPart++; continue; }

                    let levelValue;
                    if (levelStyle === 'indent') {
                        const depth = indentDepth(row, levelIndex, levelEndIndex);
                        if (depth < 0) { skippedNoLevel++; continue; }
                        levelValue = nextLevel(depth);
                    } else if (levelStyle === 'numeric') {
                        const n = parseInt(levelIndex >= 0 ? _cell(row, levelIndex) : '', 10);
                        if (!isFinite(n)) { skippedNoLevel++; continue; }
                        if (numericBase === null) numericBase = n;
                        levelValue = nextLevel(Math.max(0, n - numericBase));
                    } else {
                        levelValue = levelIndex >= 0 ? _cell(row, levelIndex) : String(i + 1);
                    }

                    const item = {
                        level: String(levelValue === undefined || levelValue === null ? '' : levelValue).trim(),
                        partNumber: partNumIndex >= 0 ? row[partNumIndex] : '',
                        description: descIndex >= 0 ? row[descIndex] : '',
                        details: detailsIndex >= 0 ? row[detailsIndex] : '',
                        revision: revisionIndex >= 0 ? row[revisionIndex] : '',
                        standardCost: costIndex >= 0 ? row[costIndex] : '',
                        quantity: qtyIndex >= 0 ? row[qtyIndex] : '1',
                        upc: upcIndex >= 0 ? row[upcIndex] : '',
                        // Left blank when there is no UOM column - the default is applied
                        // (and warned about) once, in analyzeBOMStructure.
                        uom: uomIndex >= 0 ? row[uomIndex] : '',
                        weight: weightIndex >= 0 ? row[weightIndex] : '',
                        width: widthIndex >= 0 ? row[widthIndex] : '',
                        height: heightIndex >= 0 ? row[heightIndex] : '',
                        length: lengthIndex >= 0 ? row[lengthIndex] : '',
                        vendor: vendorIndex >= 0 ? row[vendorIndex] : '',
                        vendorNumber: vendorNumIndex >= 0 ? row[vendorNumIndex] : '',
                        vendorCost: vendorCostIndex >= 0 ? row[vendorCostIndex] : '',
                        lineNumber: csvPreambleRows + i + 2, // 1-based line in the source file
                        rawData: row // Store full row for later use
                    };
                    bomItems.push(item);
                }

                // Fill in the default UOM here rather than downstream, so the parsed
                // rows, the parts list and the generated import files all agree.
                const blankUomRows = bomItems.filter(function (it) {
                    return !it.uom || String(it.uom).trim() === '';
                });
                blankUomRows.forEach(function (it) { it.uom = defaultValues.uom; });

                lastParseWarnings = {
                    skippedNoPart: skippedNoPart,
                    skippedNoLevel: skippedNoLevel,
                    clamped: nextLevel.clampedCount(),
                    // Only interesting when a UOM column exists but some cells are blank -
                    // an entirely unmapped UOM column gets its own, louder warning.
                    blankUom: uomColumnMapped ? blankUomRows.length : 0
                };
                if (lastParseWarnings.blankUom) {
                    debugLog('info', `Applied the default UOM "${defaultValues.uom}" to ${lastParseWarnings.blankUom} row(s) with a blank UOM`);
                }
                if (skippedNoPart) debugLog('info', `Ignored ${skippedNoPart} row(s) with no part number`);
                if (skippedNoLevel) debugLog('warning', `Ignored ${skippedNoLevel} row(s) with no BOM level`);
                if (lastParseWarnings.clamped) {
                    debugLog('warning', `${lastParseWarnings.clamped} row(s) skipped an indent level and were attached one level below their predecessor`);
                }

                debugLog('success', `Parsed ${bomItems.length} BOM items (level format: ${levelStyle})`);
                if (bomItems.length > 0 && levelStyle !== 'dotted') {
                    debugLog('info', 'Level conversion sample: ' +
                        bomItems.slice(0, 6).map(function (it) { return it.level + ' = ' + it.partNumber; }).join(', '));
                }

                // The existing-part list is what splits "already in Fishbowl" from
                // "new to create". Nothing loads it until the mapping or settings panel
                // is opened, so when the report auto-processes from saved mappings it
                // would otherwise report every part as new. Load it here first.
                if (config.validatePartsExist && fishbowlData.existingParts.length === 0 &&
                    typeof runQuery === 'function') {
                    debugLog('info', 'Loading Fishbowl reference data before analysis (existing-part check)');
                    showProgress('Checking which parts already exist in Fishbowl…', 70, true);
                    await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 0); });
                    try {
                        loadFishbowlData();
                    } catch (e) {
                        debugLog('warning', 'Could not load Fishbowl reference data: ' + (e && e.message ? e.message : e));
                    }
                }

                // Analyze BOM structure
                analyzeBOMStructure(bomItems);

                solidworksData = bomItems;
                showMessage(`Successfully processed ${bomItems.length} items from Solidworks BOM`, 'success');

            } catch (error) {
                debugLog('error', 'Error processing BOM data', error.toString());
                showMessage('Error processing BOM data: ' + error.message, 'danger');
            } finally {
                hideProgress();
            }
        }

        // Simple CSV line parser (handles quoted fields)
        function parseCSVLine(line) {
            const result = [];
            let current = '';
            let inQuotes = false;

            for (let i = 0; i < line.length; i++) {
                const char = line[i];

                if (char === '"') {
                    inQuotes = !inQuotes;
                } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
                    result.push(current.trim());
                    current = '';
                } else {
                    current += char;
                }
            }

            result.push(current.trim());
            return result;
        }

        // Analyze BOM structure and extract parts/BOMs
        function analyzeBOMStructure(bomItems) {
            debugLog('info', 'Analyzing BOM structure...');

            const uniqueParts = new Map();
            const bomStructure = [];
            const bomsByLevel = new Map(); // Track BOMs by their level

            // First pass: identify all unique parts and potential BOMs
            for (let i = 0; i < bomItems.length; i++) {
                const item = bomItems[i];
                const levelParts = item.level.split('.');
                const depth = levelParts.length;

                // Track unique parts - preserve ALL fields from the item
                if (item.partNumber && !uniqueParts.has(item.partNumber)) {
                    uniqueParts.set(item.partNumber, {
                        partNumber: item.partNumber,
                        description: item.description,
                        details: item.details,
                        type: item.type,
                        uom: item.uom,
                        upc: item.upc,
                        revision: item.revision,
                        standardCost: item.standardCost,
                        weight: item.weight,
                        width: item.width,
                        height: item.height,
                        length: item.length,
                        vendor: item.vendor,
                        vendorNumber: item.vendorNumber,
                        vendorCost: item.vendorCost
                    });
                }

                // Check if this item has children (is a BOM parent)
                const hasChildren = i < bomItems.length - 1 &&
                    bomItems[i + 1].level.startsWith(item.level + '.');

                if (hasChildren) {
                    // This is a BOM/assembly
                    const bom = {
                        level: item.level,
                        partNumber: item.partNumber,
                        description: item.description,
                        uom: item.uom || defaultValues.uom, // Include UOM from item or default
                        items: [],
                        isStage: depth > 1 // Sub-assemblies are stages
                    };
                    bomsByLevel.set(item.level, bom);
                    bomStructure.push(bom);
                }
            }

            // Second pass: assign items to their parent BOMs
            for (const item of bomItems) {
                const levelParts = item.level.split('.');

                // Find the parent BOM (one level up)
                if (levelParts.length > 1) {
                    const parentLevel = levelParts.slice(0, -1).join('.');
                    const parentBOM = bomsByLevel.get(parentLevel);

                    if (parentBOM) {
                        // This item belongs to the parent BOM
                        parentBOM.items.push(item);
                    }
                }
            }

            // Create wrapper BOM from filename if enabled
            if (config.createBOMFromFilename && csvFilename) {
                debugLog('info', `Creating wrapper BOM from filename: ${csvFilename}`);

                // Find all top-level BOMs (level without dots)
                const topLevelBOMs = bomStructure.filter(bom => !bom.level.includes('.'));

                if (topLevelBOMs.length > 0) {
                    // Create wrapper BOM
                    const wrapperBOM = {
                        level: '0',
                        partNumber: csvFilename,
                        description: csvFilename,
                        uom: defaultValues.uom,
                        items: topLevelBOMs.map(bom => ({
                            level: bom.level,
                            partNumber: bom.partNumber,
                            description: bom.description,
                            uom: bom.uom,
                            quantity: '1', // Each top-level BOM is qty 1 in the wrapper
                            type: 'Raw Good' // Top-level BOMs are raw goods in the wrapper BOM
                        })),
                        isStage: false // The wrapper itself is not a stage
                    };

                    bomsByLevel.set('0', wrapperBOM);
                    bomStructure.push(wrapperBOM);

                    // Add wrapper's finished good part to uniqueParts if not already present
                    if (!uniqueParts.has(csvFilename)) {
                        uniqueParts.set(csvFilename, {
                            partNumber: csvFilename,
                            description: csvFilename,
                            type: config.createFinishedGoodsAsProducts ? 'Product' : 'Inventory',
                            uom: defaultValues.uom
                        });
                    }

                    debugLog('success', `Created wrapper BOM "${csvFilename}" containing ${topLevelBOMs.length} top-level assemblies`);
                } else {
                    debugLog('warning', 'No top-level BOMs found to wrap');
                }
            }

            // Filter out parts that already exist in Fishbowl (if validation enabled)
            let allParts = Array.from(uniqueParts.values());

            // Sort BOMs by depth (deepest first) so stages are created before their parent BOMs
            bomStructure.sort((a, b) => {
                const aDepth = a.level.split('.').length;
                const bDepth = b.level.split('.').length;
                return bDepth - aDepth; // Descending order (deepest first)
            });

            bomsToCreate = bomStructure;
            debugLog('info', `BOMs sorted by depth for bottom-up creation (deepest first)`);
            if (bomsToCreate.length > 0) {
                debugLog('info', `BOM creation order example: ${bomsToCreate.slice(0, 5).map(b => `${b.level} (${b.partNumber})`).join(', ')}`);
            }

            // Validate UOMs and apply defaults for parts AND BOM items
            const invalidUOMs = [];
            const missingUOMs = [];

            // Validate part UOMs
            allParts.forEach(part => {
                // Apply default UOM if missing or empty
                if (!part.uom || part.uom.trim() === '') {
                    part.uom = defaultValues.uom;
                    missingUOMs.push(part.partNumber);
                }

                // Validate UOM against Fishbowl UOMs (if loaded)
                if (fishbowlData.uoms.length > 0 && !fishbowlData.uoms.includes(part.uom)) {
                    invalidUOMs.push({ partNumber: part.partNumber, uom: part.uom });
                }
            });

            // Validate BOM item UOMs
            bomsToCreate.forEach(bom => {
                // Validate BOM's own UOM
                if (!bom.uom || bom.uom.trim() === '') {
                    bom.uom = defaultValues.uom;
                }
                if (fishbowlData.uoms.length > 0 && !fishbowlData.uoms.includes(bom.uom)) {
                    invalidUOMs.push({ partNumber: `${bom.partNumber} (BOM)`, uom: bom.uom });
                }

                // Validate item UOMs
                bom.items.forEach(item => {
                    if (!item.uom || item.uom.trim() === '') {
                        item.uom = defaultValues.uom;
                        missingUOMs.push(`${item.partNumber} (in BOM ${bom.partNumber})`);
                    }
                    if (fishbowlData.uoms.length > 0 && !fishbowlData.uoms.includes(item.uom)) {
                        invalidUOMs.push({ partNumber: `${item.partNumber} (in BOM ${bom.partNumber})`, uom: item.uom });
                    }
                });
            });

            // Collected into the persistent banner as well as the debug log, so a
            // missed toast can't hide an assumption that changes what gets created.
            const notices = [];

            if (missingUOMs.length > 0) {
                debugLog('info', `Applied default UOM "${defaultValues.uom}" to ${missingUOMs.length} items without UOM`);
            }

            if (!uomColumnMapped) {
                const msg = `No <strong>UOM</strong> column is mapped - every new part and BOM line will be created with the default UOM "<strong>${defaultValues.uom}</strong>" (change it under Settings › Default UOM).`;
                notices.push(msg);
                debugLog('warning', `No UOM column mapped - assuming default UOM "${defaultValues.uom}" for all ${allParts.length} part(s)`);
                showMessage(`⚠️ No UOM column found - all parts will use the default UOM "${defaultValues.uom}"`, 'warning');
            } else if (lastParseWarnings.blankUom) {
                notices.push(`${lastParseWarnings.blankUom} row(s) had a blank UOM - the default UOM "<strong>${defaultValues.uom}</strong>" was applied.`);
            }

            if (invalidUOMs.length > 0) {
                debugLog('warning', `Found ${invalidUOMs.length} items with invalid UOMs (not in Fishbowl)`);
                const uniqueInvalidUOMs = [...new Set(invalidUOMs.map(item => item.uom))];
                notices.push(`${invalidUOMs.length} item(s) use a UOM that does not exist in Fishbowl (${uniqueInvalidUOMs.join(', ')}) - create these UOMs first.`);
                showMessage(`⚠️ Warning: ${invalidUOMs.length} items have invalid UOMs (${uniqueInvalidUOMs.join(', ')}). Create these UOMs in Fishbowl first.`, 'warning');
            }

            if (lastParseWarnings.skippedNoLevel) {
                notices.push(`${lastParseWarnings.skippedNoLevel} row(s) had no BOM level and were skipped.`);
            }
            if (lastParseWarnings.clamped) {
                notices.push(`${lastParseWarnings.clamped} row(s) jumped more than one indent level and were attached one level below the row above them.`);
            }
            if (config.validatePartsExist && fishbowlData.existingParts.length === 0) {
                notices.push(`Could not read the existing part list from Fishbowl, so <strong>every part is listed as new</strong>. ` +
                    `Parts that already exist are simply updated by the import, so it is safe to continue.`);
            }
            if (csvPreambleRows > 0) {
                notices.push(`${csvPreambleRows} row(s) above the column headings were ignored.`);
            }
            if (levelConfig.style === 'indent') {
                notices.push(`BOM levels were read from multiple indent columns and converted to dotted levels (e.g. 1, 1.1, 1.1.2).`);
            }

            setWarningBanner(notices);

            if (config.validatePartsExist && fishbowlData.existingParts.length > 0) {
                const existingPartsSet = new Set(fishbowlData.existingParts);
                const newParts = [];
                const existingParts = [];

                allParts.forEach(part => {
                    if (existingPartsSet.has(part.partNumber)) {
                        existingParts.push(part);
                    } else {
                        newParts.push(part);
                    }
                });

                partsToCreate = newParts;

                debugLog('success', `Parts Analysis: ${allParts.length} total in file, ${existingParts.length} already exist, ${newParts.length} new to create`);
                if (existingParts.length > 0) {
                    showMessage(`Parts: ${allParts.length} total, ${existingParts.length} exist, ${newParts.length} new to create`, 'info');
                }
            } else {
                partsToCreate = allParts;
                debugLog('success', `Parts Analysis: ${partsToCreate.length} total in file, validation ${config.validatePartsExist ? 'pending' : 'disabled'}`);
            }

            debugLog('success', `BOMs Analysis: ${bomsToCreate.length} BOMs to create/update (will override if exist)`);

            updateStats({
                total: bomItems.length,
                // "Parts" is every distinct part in the sheet; "New" is only the ones
                // that don't exist in Fishbowl yet. Reporting both as the to-create
                // count made a fully-existing BOM read as "Parts: 0".
                parts: allParts.length,
                newParts: partsToCreate.length,
                boms: bomsToCreate.length,
                warnings: notices.length,
                errors: 0
            });

            // Show parts section and BOMs section
            displayPartsToCreate();
            displayBOMsToCreate();

            // Show field mapping button
            document.getElementById('mappingButtonSection').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        // Costs looked up from Fishbowl, keyed by part number. The BOM tree renders
        // each component several times (per-BOM subtotals, nested re-renders), and
        // every miss is a blocking round-trip to the server. Cleared per analysis run
        // so re-processing after creating parts picks up fresh costs.
        let partCostCache = new Map();

        // Get part cost from CSV data or Fishbowl query
        function getPartCost(partNumber, csvCost) {
            // First try CSV vendor cost
            if (csvCost && csvCost.trim() !== '' && !isNaN(parseFloat(csvCost))) {
                return parseFloat(csvCost);
            }

            if (partCostCache.has(partNumber)) return partCostCache.get(partNumber);

            // Fallback to Fishbowl partcost.avgcost query
            if (typeof runQuery === 'function') {
                try {
                    const safeNum = (_C && _C.escSQL) ? _C.escSQL(partNumber) : String(partNumber).replace(/'/g, "''");
                    const query = `SELECT pc.avgcost
                                   FROM partcost pc
                                   JOIN part p ON p.id = pc.partid
                                   WHERE p.num = '${safeNum}'`;
                    const result = runQuery(query);
                    if (result) {
                        const data = JSON.parse(result);
                        const cost = Array.isArray(data) ? data[0]?.avgcost : data?.avgcost;
                        if (cost && !isNaN(parseFloat(cost))) {
                            const parsed = parseFloat(cost);
                            partCostCache.set(partNumber, parsed);
                            return parsed;
                        }
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    // Silently fail - cost will be 0
                }
            }

            partCostCache.set(partNumber, 0);
            return 0;
        }

        // Calculate BOM total cost recursively
        function calculateBOMCost(bom, costCache = new Map()) {
            let total = 0;

            // Calculate cost for all items in this BOM
            for (const item of bom.items) {
                const qty = parseFloat(item.quantity) || 1;

                // Check if this item is a sub-BOM
                const subBOM = bomsToCreate.find(b => b.level === item.level);

                if (subBOM) {
                    // Recursive: get the sub-BOM's total cost
                    const subCost = costCache.has(subBOM.level)
                        ? costCache.get(subBOM.level)
                        : calculateBOMCost(subBOM, costCache);
                    costCache.set(subBOM.level, subCost);
                    total += subCost * qty;
                } else {
                    // Regular part: get unit cost and multiply by quantity
                    const unitCost = getPartCost(item.partNumber, item.vendorCost);
                    total += unitCost * qty;
                }
            }

            return total;
        }

        // Toggle BOM row expansion
        function toggleBOMRow(bomId) {
            const detailRows = document.querySelectorAll(`.bom-detail-${bomId}`);
            const chevron = document.getElementById(`chevron-${bomId}`);
            const isExpanded = detailRows[0]?.style.display !== 'none';

            detailRows.forEach(row => {
                row.style.display = isExpanded ? 'none' : 'table-row';
            });

            if (chevron) {
                chevron.style.transform = isExpanded ? 'rotate(-90deg)' : 'rotate(0deg)';
            }
        }

        // Build BOM tree rows recursively
        function buildBOMTreeRows(bom, depth = 0, costCache = new Map(), allRows = []) {
            const bomId = bom.level.replace(/\./g, '-');
            const indent = depth * 20;
            const bomCost = costCache.has(bom.level)
                ? costCache.get(bom.level)
                : calculateBOMCost(bom, costCache);
            costCache.set(bom.level, bomCost);

            const bgColor = depth === 0 ? '#bae6fd' : (depth === 1 ? '#e2e8f0' : '#f1f5f9');

            // BOM quantity defaults to 1 (or could be retrieved from parent if needed)
            const bomQty = 1;
            const bomUnitCost = bomCost; // Cost per unit of this BOM
            const bomTotalCost = bomUnitCost * bomQty;

            const typeLabel = bom.isStage ? '<span class="badge bg-info" style="font-size: 7px;">Stage</span>' : '<span class="badge bg-primary" style="font-size: 7px;">FG</span>';

            // BOM header row (clickable to expand/collapse) - matches detail row columns
            allRows.push(`
                <tr class="bom-header-row" style="background-color: ${bgColor}; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500;" onclick="toggleBOMRow('${bomId}')">
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; padding-left: ${indent + 8}px;">
                        <i id="chevron-${bomId}" class="bi bi-chevron-right" style="transition: transform 0.2s; display: inline-block;"></i>
                        <strong style="margin-left: 8px;">${bom.level}</strong>
                    </td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px;">${bom.partNumber}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px;">${bom.description || bom.partNumber} ${typeLabel}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">${bomQty}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px;">${bom.uom || 'ea'}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; font-weight: 600;">$${bomUnitCost.toFixed(2)}</td>
                    <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; font-weight: 600; color: #198754;">$${bomTotalCost.toFixed(2)}</td>
                </tr>
            `);

            // Component rows - iterate through items and inline sub-BOMs
            for (const item of bom.items) {
                // Special handling for wrapper BOM (level 0) - directly recurse into top-level BOMs
                if (bom.level === '0') {
                    // Find the actual BOM object for this top-level BOM
                    const topLevelBOM = bomsToCreate.find(b =>
                        b.partNumber === item.partNumber && b.level === item.level
                    );

                    if (topLevelBOM) {
                        // Recursively render this top-level BOM with wrapper's detail class
                        const nestedRows = [];
                        buildBOMTreeRows(topLevelBOM, depth + 1, costCache, nestedRows);

                        // Add all rows with parent's detail class
                        nestedRows.forEach(row => {
                            if (row.includes('class="')) {
                                allRows.push(row.replace('class="', `class="bom-detail-${bomId} `));
                            } else {
                                allRows.push(row.replace('<tr ', `<tr class="bom-detail-${bomId}" `));
                            }
                        });
                        continue; // Skip the regular item rendering below
                    }
                }

                const subBOM = bomsToCreate.find(b => b.level === item.level);

                if (subBOM) {
                    // This item is a sub-BOM - render it inline as a nested BOM with its own expand/collapse
                    // Add it to the parent's detail class so it shows/hides with parent
                    const subBomId = subBOM.level.replace(/\./g, '-');
                    const subIndent = (depth + 1) * 20;
                    const subBomCost = costCache.has(subBOM.level)
                        ? costCache.get(subBOM.level)
                        : calculateBOMCost(subBOM, costCache);
                    costCache.set(subBOM.level, subBomCost);

                    const qty = parseFloat(item.quantity) || 1;
                    const extended = subBomCost * qty;
                    const subBgColor = depth === 0 ? '#e2e8f0' : '#f1f5f9';

                    // Display badge based on item type (Raw Good vs Stage)
                    const itemType = item.type || 'Stage';
                    const subTypeLabel = itemType === 'Raw Good'
                        ? '<span class="badge bg-success" style="font-size: 7px;">Raw Good</span>'
                        : '<span class="badge bg-info" style="font-size: 7px;">Stage</span>';

                    // Sub-BOM header row (part of parent's detail)
                    allRows.push(`
                        <tr class="bom-detail-${bomId} bom-header-row" style="display: none; background-color: ${subBgColor}; cursor: pointer; font-weight: 500;" onclick="toggleBOMRow('${subBomId}')">
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px; padding-left: ${subIndent + 8}px;">
                                <i id="chevron-${subBomId}" class="bi bi-chevron-right" style="transition: transform 0.2s; display: inline-block;"></i>
                                <strong style="margin-left: 8px;">${subBOM.level}</strong>
                            </td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px;">${subBOM.partNumber}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px;">${subBOM.description || subBOM.partNumber} ${subTypeLabel}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right;">${qty}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px;">${subBOM.uom || 'ea'}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; font-weight: 600;">$${subBomCost.toFixed(2)}</td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; font-weight: 600; color: #198754;">$${extended.toFixed(2)}</td>
                        </tr>
                    `);

                    // Recursively add sub-BOM's components
                    for (const subItem of subBOM.items) {
                        const nestedSubBOM = bomsToCreate.find(b => b.level === subItem.level);

                        if (nestedSubBOM) {
                            // Another level of nesting - recursively call buildBOMTreeRows
                            const nestedRows = [];
                            buildBOMTreeRows(nestedSubBOM, depth + 2, costCache, nestedRows);
                            // Add nested rows with both parent detail classes
                            nestedRows.forEach(row => {
                                if (row.includes('class="')) {
                                    allRows.push(row.replace('class="', `class="bom-detail-${bomId} bom-detail-${subBomId} `));
                                } else {
                                    allRows.push(row.replace('<tr ', `<tr class="bom-detail-${bomId} bom-detail-${subBomId}" `));
                                }
                            });
                        } else {
                            // Regular component of sub-BOM
                            const subItemQty = parseFloat(subItem.quantity) || 1;
                            const subItemUnitCost = getPartCost(subItem.partNumber, subItem.vendorCost);
                            const subItemExtended = subItemUnitCost * subItemQty;

                            allRows.push(`
                                <tr class="bom-detail-${bomId} bom-detail-${subBomId}" style="display: none; background-color: white;">
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; padding-left: ${subIndent + 40}px; font-size: 10pt;">${subItem.level}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 10pt;">${subItem.partNumber}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 10pt;">${subItem.description || ''}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; text-align: right; font-size: 10pt;">${subItemQty}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; font-size: 10pt;">${subItem.uom || 'ea'}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; text-align: right; font-size: 10pt;">$${subItemUnitCost.toFixed(2)}</td>
                                    <td style="padding: 4px 8px; text-align: right; font-size: 10pt;">$${subItemExtended.toFixed(2)}</td>
                                </tr>
                            `);
                        }
                    }

                    // Sub-BOM subtotal row
                    allRows.push(`
                        <tr class="bom-detail-${bomId} bom-detail-${subBomId}" style="display: none; background-color: #eff6ff; border-top: 2px solid #2d9cdb;">
                            <td colspan="6" style="padding: 6px 8px; padding-left: ${subIndent + 40}px; font-size: 9.5pt; font-weight: 700; text-align: right;">
                                BOM ${subBOM.level} Subtotal:
                            </td>
                            <td style="padding: 6px 8px; text-align: right; font-size: 10pt; font-weight: 700; color: #1e7bb4;">
                                $${subBomCost.toFixed(2)}
                            </td>
                        </tr>
                    `);
                } else {
                    // Regular component - render as detail row
                    const qty = parseFloat(item.quantity) || 1;
                    const unitCost = getPartCost(item.partNumber, item.vendorCost);
                    const extended = unitCost * qty;

                    allRows.push(`

                    fishbowlData.uoms = [];
                    fishbowlData.uomDetails = [];

                // Load Vendors

                const vendorQuery = `SELECT name FROM vendor WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY name`;
                const vendorResult = runQuery(vendorQuery);

                if (vendorResult) {
                    let vendors = JSON.parse(vendorResult);
                    if (vendors && !Array.isArray(vendors)) vendors = [vendors];
                    fishbowlData.vendors = vendors.map(v => v.name);
                    debugLog('success', `Loaded ${fishbowlData.vendors.length} Vendors`);
                } else {
                    debugLog('warning', 'No Vendors loaded from Fishbowl');
                    fishbowlData.vendors = [];
                }

                // Load Tax Codes
                debugLog('info', 'Loading Tax Codes...');
                const taxQuery = `SELECT code, name FROM taxrate WHERE activeflag = 1 ORDER BY code`;
                const taxResult = runQuery(taxQuery);

                if (taxResult) {
                    let taxCodes = JSON.parse(taxResult);
                    if (taxCodes && !Array.isArray(taxCodes)) taxCodes = [taxCodes];
                    fishbowlData.taxCodes = taxCodes.map(t => t.code);
                    fishbowlData.taxCodeDetails = taxCodes; // Store full details
                    debugLog('success', `Loaded ${fishbowlData.taxCodes.length} Tax Codes`);
                } else {
                    debugLog('warning', 'No Tax Codes loaded from Fishbowl');
                    fishbowlData.taxCodes = [];
                    fishbowlData.taxCodeDetails = [];
                }

                // Load Existing Parts (for validation)
                debugLog('info', 'Loading existing parts from Fishbowl...');
                const partsQuery = `SELECT num FROM part WHERE activeflag = 1`;
                const partsResult = runQuery(partsQuery);

                if (partsResult) {

                // Populate settings dropdowns if they exist
                populateSettingsDropdowns();

                return true;

                debugLog('error', 'Error loading Fishbowl data', error.toString());
                showMessage('Warning: Could not load data from Fishbowl', 'warning');
                return false;
            }
        }

        function createMappingRow(fishbowlField, isRequired, level, index, description) {
            const row = document.createElement('div');

            arrow.innerHTML = '←';
