            select.className = 'mapping-select form-select';
            select.id = `mapping-${level}-${index}`;
            select.dataset.field = fishbowlField;
            select.dataset.level = level;
            select.dataset.required = isRequired;

            // Add "None" option
            const noneOption = document.createElement('option');
            noneOption.value = '';
            noneOption.textContent = '-- None --';
            select.appendChild(noneOption);

            // Determine the single best auto-match column for this field (only when
            // there's no saved mapping). Scoring + best-pick avoids the old
            // "last substring match wins" bug where Number grabbed Vendor Number.
            let bestCol = null;
            if (!fieldMappings[fishbowlField]) {
                let bestScore = 0;
                solidworksColumns.forEach(col => {
                    const sc = autoMatchScore(fishbowlField, col);
                    if (sc > bestScore) { bestScore = sc; bestCol = col; }
                });
            }

            // Add Solidworks column options
            solidworksColumns.forEach(col => {
                const option = document.createElement('option');
                option.value = col;
                option.textContent = col;

                if (fieldMappings[fishbowlField]) {
                    // A saved/loaded mapping takes priority.
                    if (fieldMappings[fishbowlField] === col) option.selected = true;
                } else if (col === bestCol) {
                    // Otherwise pre-select the single best auto-match.
                    option.selected = true;
                }

                select.appendChild(option);
            });

            row.appendChild(labelDiv);
            row.appendChild(arrow);
            row.appendChild(select);

            return row;
        }

        // Score how well a Solidworks column matches a Fishbowl field. Higher = better.
        // An exact name match always wins; keyword lists are kept tight and specific so
        // generic tokens (e.g. "number") don't let "Vendor Number" steal the "Number"
        // field. Callers pick the single highest-scoring column per field.
        function autoMatchScore(fishbowlField, solidworksColumn) {
            const fb = String(fishbowlField).toLowerCase().trim();
            const sw = String(solidworksColumn).toLowerCase().trim();
            if (!sw) return 0;
            if (fb === sw) return 1000;   // exact column name == field name

            // Specific keyword lists — avoid bare tokens shared across fields
            // (no lone "number"/"part"/"cost"/"w"/"h"/"l").
            const mappings = {
                'level': ['level'],
                'number': ['part number', 'partnumber', 'part num', 'part no', 'part #', 'p/n', 'pn'],
                'description': ['description', 'desc', 'part name', 'item name'],
                'details': ['details', 'notes', 'comments'],
                'revision': ['revision', 'rev'],
                'standard cost': ['standard cost', 'std cost', 'stdcost'],
                'quantity': ['quantity', 'qty', 'qnty'],
                'upc': ['upc', 'barcode', 'ean'],
                'uom': ['uom', 'u/m', 'unit of measure'],
                'weight': ['weight', 'wt', 'mass'],
                'width': ['width'],
                'height': ['height'],
                'length': ['length', 'len'],
                'vendor': ['vendor', 'supplier', 'manufacturer', 'mfg'],
                'vendor number': ['vendor number', 'vendor p/n', 'vendor part', 'vendor no', 'mfg part', 'manufacturer part'],
                'vendor cost': ['vendor cost', 'purchase cost', 'buy cost']
            };
            // Tokens that are only trusted as a WHOLE column name. "Name" is a common
            // description heading, but as a substring it would also grab "Vendor Name".
            const exactOnly = { 'description': ['name'] };

            const kws = mappings[fb] || [fb];
            let best = 0;
            for (const k of kws) {
                if (sw === k) best = Math.max(best, 900);                  // exact keyword
                else if (sw.includes(k)) best = Math.max(best, 100 + k.length); // substring; longer = more specific
            }
            (exactOnly[fb] || []).forEach(function (k) {
                if (sw === k) best = Math.max(best, 890);
            });
            return best;
        }

        function saveMappings() {
            debugLog('info', 'Saving field mappings...');

            const mappings = {};

            // Collect all field mappings
            const allSelects = document.querySelectorAll('select[data-level="bom"]');
            let hasErrors = false;

            allSelects.forEach(select => {
                const field = select.dataset.field;
                const isRequired = select.dataset.required === 'true';
                const value = select.value;

                if (isRequired && !value) {
                    showMessage(`Required field "${field}" must be mapped`, 'danger');
                    select.classList.add('is-invalid');
                    hasErrors = true;
                } else {
                    select.classList.remove('is-invalid');
                    if (value) {
                        mappings[field] = value;
                    }
                }
            });

            if (hasErrors) {
                debugLog('error', 'Field mapping validation failed - required fields missing');
                return;
            }

            // The level format is kept out of fieldMappings: its values aren't column
            // names, and fieldMappings gets validated against the CSV's column list.
            const styleSel = document.getElementById('levelStyleSelect');
            const endSel = document.getElementById('levelEndSelect');
            const newStyle = styleSel ? styleSel.value : (levelConfig.style || 'dotted');
            const newEnd = endSel ? endSel.value : levelConfig.endCol;

            if (newStyle === 'indent') {
                const startIdx = solidworksColumns.indexOf(mappings['Level']);
                const endIdx = newEnd ? solidworksColumns.indexOf(newEnd) : -1;
                if (endIdx < 0 || endIdx <= startIdx) {
                    showMessage('For multi-column levels, "Last Level Column" must be to the right of the "Level" column', 'danger');
                    if (endSel) endSel.classList.add('is-invalid');
                    debugLog('error', 'Invalid multi-column level span');
                    return;
                }
                if (endSel) endSel.classList.remove('is-invalid');
            }

            levelConfig = {
                style: newStyle,
                endCol: newStyle === 'indent' ? newEnd : null,
                autoDetected: false
            };
            debugLog('info', 'BOM level format: ' + newStyle + (newStyle === 'indent' ? ' (through "' + newEnd + '")' : ''));

            fieldMappings = mappings;
            debugLog('success', 'Field mappings saved', fieldMappings);

            // Save to user settings for future use
            saveFieldMappings(mappings);

            showMessage('Field mappings saved successfully', 'success');

            // Close the modal
            closeFieldMappingModal();

            // Now process the BOM data with the configured mappings
            processBOMData();
        }

        // Load saved mappings from the Fishbowl user account.
        function loadSavedMappings() {
            try {
                const mappingData = _resolve('fieldMappings', null);
                if (!mappingData || !mappingData.mappings) return;

                debugLog('info', 'Found saved mappings from ' + (mappingData.timestamp || 'a previous session'));

                // Match saved mappings by COLUMN NAME, not by requiring the CSV's
                // column array to be byte-identical (same length AND order) to when
                // they were saved. Two exports of the same report often differ in
                // column order or carry extra columns; the old strict check made
                // auto-import silently fail in those cases. Keep every saved mapping
                // whose source column is still present, and only fall back to manual
                // configuration when a REQUIRED field's column is genuinely gone.
                const saved = mappingData.mappings || {};
                const currentCols = solidworksColumns || [];
                const usable = {};
                const droppedOptional = [];
                Object.keys(saved).forEach(function (field) {
                    const col = saved[field];
                    if (col && currentCols.indexOf(col) !== -1) usable[field] = col;
                    else if (col) droppedOptional.push(field);
                });

                const requiredMissing = Object.keys(bomFieldDefinitions).filter(function (f) {
                    return bomFieldDefinitions[f].required && !usable[f];
                });

                if (Object.keys(usable).length === 0 || requiredMissing.length > 0) {
                    debugLog('warning', 'Saved mappings do not cover this CSV — missing required: ' + (requiredMissing.join(', ') || '(none usable)'));
                    showMessage('Saved mappings don\'t match this CSV\'s columns — please configure field mapping.', 'warning');
                    return;
                }

                fieldMappings = usable;

                // Restore the saved level format, but only when it still fits this CSV -
                // otherwise keep whatever the loader auto-detected.
                if (mappingData.levelConfig && mappingData.levelConfig.style) {
                    const lc = mappingData.levelConfig;
                    if (lc.style !== 'indent' || (lc.endCol && currentCols.indexOf(lc.endCol) !== -1)) {
                        levelConfig = { style: lc.style, endCol: lc.endCol || null, autoDetected: false };
                        debugLog('info', 'Restored saved BOM level format: ' + lc.style);
                    } else {
                        debugLog('warning', 'Saved multi-column level span is not in this CSV - keeping the auto-detected format');
                    }
                }

                // No-op if the mapping modal isn't built yet; processBOMData reads
                // fieldMappings directly, so auto-processing still works.
                applyMappingsToUI();

                if (droppedOptional.length) {
                    debugLog('info', 'Saved mappings applied; optional field(s) not found in this CSV: ' + droppedOptional.join(', '));
                    showMessage('Loaded saved field mappings (optional column(s) not found: ' + droppedOptional.join(', ') + ')', 'info');
                } else {
                    debugLog('success', 'Saved mappings applied to current CSV');
                    showMessage('Loaded saved field mappings from a previous session', 'success');
                }

                if (rawCSVContent) {
                    debugLog('info', 'Auto-processing BOM with saved mappings');
                    setTimeout(function () { processBOMData(); }, 300);

        // Pre-flight: every part a BOM references (its own finished-good part AND
        // each component) must already exist in Fishbowl, or the bomitem insert
        // fails with a "partId FK constraint" error (the parts must be created
        // first). Re-query the live part table so we don't trust a stale cache.
        // Returns the list of referenced part numbers that don't exist yet
        // (empty when all exist, or when running offline / the check can't run).
        function findMissingBomParts() {
            if (typeof runQuery !== 'function') return []; // offline — can't verify

            const needed = new Set();
            bomsToCreate.forEach(bom => {
                if (bom.partNumber) needed.add(bom.partNumber);
                (bom.items || []).forEach(it => { if (it.partNumber) needed.add(it.partNumber); });
            });
            if (needed.size === 0) return [];

            try {
                const esc = (n) => (_C && _C.escSQL) ? _C.escSQL(n) : String(n).replace(/'/g, "''");
                const inList = Array.from(needed).map(n => "'" + esc(n) + "'").join(',');
                const res = runQuery(`SELECT num FROM part WHERE num IN (${inList})`);
                let rows = res ? JSON.parse(res) : [];
                if (rows && !Array.isArray(rows)) rows = [rows];
                const existing = new Set(rows.map(r => r.num));
                return Array.from(needed).filter(n => !existing.has(n));
            } catch (e) {
                debugLog('warning', 'Could not pre-check part existence (proceeding anyway)', e.toString());
                return []; // never block on a checker failure
            }
        }

        // Fishbowl reports import failures as "Line Number: N", counted over the Row
        // array we sent. Translate those numbers into the BOM/part they came from so
        // the user doesn't have to reconstruct the CSV and count lines by hand.
        function explainImportLines(message, rowMeta) {
            const out = [];
            const re = /Line Number:\s*(\d+)/g;
            let m;
            while ((m = re.exec(String(message == null ? '' : message))) !== null) {
                const n = parseInt(m[1], 10);
                const what = rowMeta[n - 1];
                const label = what ? 'line ' + n + ' = ' + what : 'line ' + n + ' = (outside the rows sent)';
                if (out.indexOf(label) === -1) out.push(label);
            }
            return out;
        }

        async function importBOMsToFishbowl() {
            debugLog('info', 'Starting direct BOM import to Fishbowl (batched by level)...');

            if (bomsToCreate.length === 0) {
                showMessage('No BOMs to import', 'warning');
                return;
            }

            // Check if mappings are configured (new flat structure)
            if (!fieldMappings || Object.keys(fieldMappings).length === 0) {
                showMessage('Please configure field mappings first', 'warning');
                debugLog('warning', 'Field mappings not configured');
                return;
            }

            // Pre-flight: block the import if any referenced part is missing, so the
            // user gets a clear "create these parts first" message instead of a raw
            // Fishbowl "partId foreign key constraint fails" error mid-import.
            const missingParts = findMissingBomParts();
            if (missingParts.length > 0) {
                const preview = missingParts.slice(0, 10).join(', ') +
                    (missingParts.length > 10 ? ` …(+${missingParts.length - 10} more)` : '');
                showMessage(`Cannot create BOMs — ${missingParts.length} referenced part(s) don't exist in Fishbowl yet: ${preview}. Click "Create Parts" first, then try again.`, 'danger');
                debugLog('error', `BOM import blocked — ${missingParts.length} part(s) missing from Fishbowl`, missingParts);
                return;
            }

            // Auto-load BOM import headers if not loaded
            if (!bomLevelHeaders.length || !itemLevelHeaders.length) {
                debugLog('info', 'BOM import headers not loaded - loading now...');
                checkBOMImportHeaders();

                if (!bomLevelHeaders.length || !itemLevelHeaders.length) {
                    showMessage('Failed to load BOM import headers', 'danger');
                    return;
                }
            }

            try {
                // ── Batch by BOM level, DEEPEST first ─────────────────────────────
                // Some Fishbowl versions won't resolve a StageBOMNumber that points at
                // a BOM being created in the SAME ImportRq. So rather than one big
                // import, send one ImportRq per level depth, deepest sub-assemblies
                // first: each wave is committed before the (shallower) BOMs that stage
                // it are imported, and the whole payload stays small (helps large/deep
                // structures and import size limits too). Depth = number of dotted
                // segments in the BOM's level; the optional filename-wrapper BOM
                // (level '0') is forced shallowest so it lands in the final wave.
                const depthOf = function (bom) {
                    const lvl = String(bom.level == null ? '' : bom.level);
                    return lvl === '0' ? 0 : lvl.split('.').length;
                };
                const byDepth = new Map();
                bomsToCreate.forEach(function (bom) {
                    const d = depthOf(bom);
                    if (!byDepth.has(d)) byDepth.set(d, []);
                    byDepth.get(d).push(bom);
                });
                const depths = Array.from(byDepth.keys()).sort(function (a, b) { return b - a; }); // deepest first

                const headerRow1 = bomLevelHeaders.map(function (h) { return `"${h}"`; }).join(',');
                const headerRow2 = itemLevelHeaders.map(function (h) { return `"${h}"`; }).join(',');

                debugLog('info', `Importing ${bomsToCreate.length} BOM(s) across ${depths.length} level-wave(s): ` +
                    depths.map(function (d) { return `L${d}×${byDepth.get(d).length}`; }).join(', '));

                let waveOk = 0, bomsOk = 0;

                for (let w = 0; w < depths.length; w++) {
                    const depth = depths[w];
                    const group = byDepth.get(depth);

                    // Each wave is a self-contained BOM import CSV (its own two header
                    // rows + this level's BOM / finished-good / item rows). rowMeta
                    // mirrors rows 1:1 so a reported line number can be named.
                    const rows = [headerRow1, headerRow2];
                    const rowMeta = ['(BOM header row)', '(item header row)'];
                    group.forEach(function (bom) {
                        rows.push(generateBOMRow(bom));
                        rowMeta.push('BOM record for ' + bom.partNumber);
                        rows.push(generateFinishedGoodRow(bom));
                        rowMeta.push('finished good ' + bom.partNumber);
                        bom.items.forEach(function (item) {
                            rows.push(generateItemRow(bom, item));
                            rowMeta.push('component ' + (item.partNumber || '(blank part number)') +
                                ' at level ' + item.level + ' of BOM ' + bom.partNumber);
                        });
                    });

                    const payload = { "ImportRq": { "Type": "ImportBillOfMaterials", "Rows": { "Row": rows } } };

                    showProgress(`Importing level ${depth} — ${group.length} BOM${group.length === 1 ? '' : 's'} (wave ${w + 1} of ${depths.length})…`,
                        Math.round((w / depths.length) * 100), true);
                    // Yield so the progress bar/spinner repaints between the (blocking) API calls.
                    await new Promise(function (r) { setTimeout(r, 0); });

                    debugLog('info', `Wave ${w + 1}/${depths.length}: importing ${group.length} level-${depth} BOM(s)`,
                        group.map(function (b) { return b.partNumber; }));

                    let ok = false, msg = '';
                    try {
                        const response = runApiRequest('ImportRq', JSON.stringify(payload));
                        if (!response) {
                            msg = 'No response from API';
                        } else {
                            const result = typeof response === 'string' ? JSON.parse(response) : response;
                            // Log the raw response so the debug console shows the exact
                            // line numbers / messages Fishbowl reported for this wave.
                            debugLog('query', `Wave ${w + 1} raw API response`, result);
                            if (result && result.ImportRs && (result.ImportRs.statusCode === 1000 || result.ImportRs.statusCode === '1000')) {
                                ok = true;
                            } else {
                                msg = (result && result.ImportRs && result.ImportRs.statusMessage) || 'Unexpected response format';
                            }
                        }
                    } catch (waveErr) {
                        msg = waveErr && waveErr.message ? waveErr.message : String(waveErr);
                    }

                    if (ok) {
                        waveOk++; bomsOk += group.length;
                        debugLog('success', `Wave ${w + 1} committed (${group.length} level-${depth} BOM(s))`);
                    } else {
                        // A wave failed — the shallower waves stage these BOMs, so stop
                        // here rather than push parents whose stage links will dangle.
                        hideProgress();

                        // Name the rows Fishbowl complained about, and recognise the
                        // partId foreign-key failure: when the part genuinely exists,
                        // that is the Fishbowl server holding a stale part cache rather
                        // than anything wrong with the sheet.
                        const named = explainImportLines(msg, rowMeta);
                        const namedNote = named.length ? ` Reported row(s): ${named.join('; ')}.` : '';
                        const fkNote = /foreign key constraint fails[\s\S]*partId/i.test(msg)
                            ? ` This is a partId foreign-key failure. If the part above already exists in Fishbowl ` +
                              `(check the Part module), the server is holding a stale part cache — restart the Fishbowl ` +
                              `server, then click Create BOMs again.`
                            : '';

                        debugLog('error', `Wave ${w + 1} (level ${depth}) failed: ${msg}`);
                        if (named.length) debugLog('error', 'Failing row(s) resolved to: ' + named.join(' | '));
                        showMessage(`BOM import stopped at level ${depth} (wave ${w + 1} of ${depths.length}): ${msg}.` +
                            namedNote + fkNote +
                            ` ${bomsOk} deeper BOM(s) were committed; the ${group.length} level-${depth} BOM(s) and anything above were not. ` +
                            `Fix the reported item and re-run — already-created BOMs are simply updated.`, 'danger');
                        return;
                    }
                }

                hideProgress();
                showMessage(`✓ Imported ${bomsOk} BOM(s) to Fishbowl across ${waveOk} level-wave(s).`, 'success');
                debugLog('success', `BOM import complete — ${bomsOk} BOM(s) in ${waveOk} wave(s)`);
                updateBOMsStatus('imported');

            } catch (error) {
                hideProgress();
                debugLog('error', 'Error during BOM import', error.toString());
                showMessage('Error importing BOMs: ' + error.message, 'danger');
            }
        }

        // Update parts table status
        function updatePartsStatus(status) {
            const tbody = document.getElementById('partsTableBody');
            const rows = tbody.getElementsByTagName('tr');

            for (const row of rows) {
                const statusCell = row.cells[4]; // Updated index (was 3, now 4 due to UOM column)
                if (status === 'imported') {
                    statusCell.innerHTML = '<span class="badge bg-success">Imported</span>';
                }
            }
        }

        // Update BOMs table status
        function updateBOMsStatus(status) {
            // New table structure doesn't have status column
            // Status is already shown via toast messages
            // This function is now a no-op for backwards compatibility
            if (status === 'imported') {
                debugLog('success', 'BOMs status updated to imported');
            }
        }

        // Show/hide progress indicator. Pass spinner=true to prepend a small spinning
        // indicator to the message (used for open-ended work like BOM processing).
        function showProgress(message, percent, spinner) {
            const progressSection = document.getElementById('progressSection');
            const progressText = document.getElementById('progressText');
            const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar');

            var spin = spinner
                ? '<span class="spin" style="display:inline-block;width:12px;height:12px;border:2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.15);border-top-color:var(--color-primary);border-radius:50%;margin-right:8px;vertical-align:-2px;"></span>'
                : '';
            progressText.innerHTML = spin + String(message == null ? '' : message).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<');
            progressBar.style.width = (percent == null ? 0 : percent) + '%';
            progressSection.classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        function hideProgress() {
            const progressSection = document.getElementById('progressSection');
            progressSection.classList.add('hidden');
        }

        function downloadCSV(csvContent, filename) {
            debugLog('info', `Downloading CSV file: ${filename}`);

            const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
            const link = document.createElement('a');

            if (link.download !== undefined) {
                const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
                link.setAttribute('href', url);
                link.setAttribute('download', filename);
                link.style.visibility = 'hidden';
                document.body.appendChild(link);
                link.click();
                document.body.removeChild(link);
                URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

                debugLog('success', `CSV file downloaded: ${filename}`);
            } else {
                showMessage('Download not supported in this browser', 'danger');
                debugLog('error', 'Download not supported');
            }
        }

        // ============================================================
        // TOAST MESSAGES (house slide-in)
        // ============================================================
        function showMessage(message, type = 'info') {
            // Map the tool's Bootstrap-style types to house toast classes.
            const kind = type === 'danger' ? 'error' : (type === 'warning' ? 'warn' : type);
            const icons = { success: '✓', error: '✕', warn: '⚠', info: 'ℹ' };
            const container = document.getElementById('toastContainer');
            if (!container) { console.log('[' + type + ']', message); return; }

            const toast = document.createElement('div');
            toast.className = 'toast ' + kind;
            toast.setAttribute('role', 'alert');
            toast.innerHTML = `
                <span class="toast-icon">${icons[kind] || icons.info}</span>
                <span class="toast-msg">${String(message)}</span>
                <button type="button" class="toast-x" aria-label="Close">×</button>
            `;
            toast.querySelector('.toast-x').addEventListener('click', function () {
                toast.style.opacity = '0';
                setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
            });
            container.appendChild(toast);

            // Auto-dismiss success/info after 5s (errors/warnings stay until dismissed)
            if (kind === 'success' || kind === 'info') {
                setTimeout(() => {
                    toast.style.opacity = '0';
                    setTimeout(() => toast.remove(), 250);
                }, 5000);
            }
        }

        function updateStats(stats) {
            document.getElementById('statTotal').textContent = stats.total || 0;
            document.getElementById('statParts').textContent = stats.parts || 0;
            document.getElementById('statNewParts').textContent = stats.newParts || 0;
            document.getElementById('statBOMs').textContent = stats.boms || 0;
            document.getElementById('statWarnings').textContent = stats.warnings || 0;
            document.getElementById('statErrors').textContent = stats.errors || 0;

            document.getElementById('summaryStats').classList.remove('hidden');
        }

        // Populate settings dropdowns with Fishbowl data
        function populateSettingsDropdowns() {
            // Populate UOM dropdown
            const uomSelect = document.getElementById('defaultUOM');
            if (uomSelect && fishbowlData.uomDetails.length > 0) {
                // Clear existing options except the first (ea)
                while (uomSelect.options.length > 1) {
                    uomSelect.remove(1);
                }

                // Add UOMs from Fishbowl with name
                fishbowlData.uomDetails.forEach(uom => {
                    if (uom.code !== 'ea') { // Don't duplicate ea
                        const option = document.createElement('option');
                        option.value = uom.code;
                        option.textContent = `${uom.code} - ${uom.name || uom.code}`;
                        uomSelect.appendChild(option);
                    }
                });

                debugLog('success', `Populated ${fishbowlData.uomDetails.length} UOMs in settings`);
            }

            // Populate Tax Code dropdown
            const taxCodeSelect = document.getElementById('defaultTaxCode');
            if (taxCodeSelect && fishbowlData.taxCodeDetails.length > 0) {
                // Clear existing options except the first (NON)
                while (taxCodeSelect.options.length > 1) {
                    taxCodeSelect.remove(1);
                }

                // Add tax codes from Fishbowl with name
                fishbowlData.taxCodeDetails.forEach(tax => {
                    if (tax.code !== 'NON') { // Don't duplicate NON
                        const option = document.createElement('option');
                        option.value = tax.code;
                        option.textContent = `${tax.code} - ${tax.name || tax.code}`;
                        taxCodeSelect.appendChild(option);
                    }
                });

                debugLog('success', `Populated ${fishbowlData.taxCodeDetails.length} tax codes in settings`);
            }

            // Load saved settings after populating dropdowns
            hydrateSettings();
        }

        // ============================================================
        // SETTINGS PERSISTENCE — Fishbowl user account via FBLib.Settings
        // (replaces the old localStorage path, which Fishbowl clears).
        // ============================================================
        function _val(id, dflt) { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.value : dflt; }
        function _chk(id, dflt) { const el = document.getElementById(id); return el ? el.checked : dflt; }
        function _setVal(id, v) { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && v !== undefined && v !== null) el.value = v; }
        function _setChk(id, v) { const el = document.getElementById(id); if (el && v !== undefined) el.checked = !!v; }

        function _collectSettings() {
            return {
                defaultUOM: _val('defaultUOM', 'ea'),
                defaultTaxCode: _val('defaultTaxCode', 'NON'),
                defaultWeightUOM: _val('defaultWeightUOM', 'kg'),
                defaultSizeUOM: _val('defaultSizeUOM', 'cm'),
                createAsInventory: _chk('createAsInventory', true),
                createFinishedGoodsAsProducts: _chk('createFinishedGoodsAsProducts', false),
                validatePartsExist: _chk('validatePartsExist', true),
                processStagesSequentially: _chk('processStagesSequentially', true),
                createBOMFromFilename: _chk('createBOMFromFilename', false),
                autoCreateType: _val('autoCreateType', 'Build To Order')
            };
        }

        function _applyToConfig(s) {
            defaultValues.uom = s.defaultUOM || 'ea';
            defaultValues.taxCode = s.defaultTaxCode || 'NON';
            defaultValues.weightUOM = s.defaultWeightUOM || 'kg';
            defaultValues.sizeUOM = s.defaultSizeUOM || 'cm';
            config.createAsInventory = s.createAsInventory !== false;
            config.createFinishedGoodsAsProducts = !!s.createFinishedGoodsAsProducts;
            config.validatePartsExist = s.validatePartsExist !== false;
            config.processStagesSequentially = s.processStagesSequentially !== false;
            config.createBOMFromFilename = !!s.createBOMFromFilename;
            config.autoCreateType = s.autoCreateType || 'Build To Order';
        }

        // Save settings to the Fishbowl user account
        function persistSettings() {
            const s = _collectSettings();
            _applyToConfig(s);
            try {
                if (_settingsReady()) {
                    Object.keys(s).forEach(function (k) { FBLib.Settings.setUserKey(k, s[k]); });
                    FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
                    debugLog('info', 'Settings saved to your Fishbowl user account');
                } else {
                    debugLog('info', 'Settings applied (settings bridge unavailable — not persisted)');
                }
            } catch (error) {
                debugLog('warning', 'Could not persist settings: ' + error);
            }

            // A settings change can alter the computed structure (part type, filename
            // wrapper, auto-create type, UOM defaults…), so re-run the analysis if a
            // sheet is already loaded and mapped.
            if (rawCSVContent && fieldMappings && Object.keys(fieldMappings).length > 0) {
                debugLog('info', 'Setting changed — reprocessing loaded BOM');
                processBOMData();
            }
        }

        // Load settings from the Fishbowl user account into the controls + config
        function hydrateSettings() {
            const s = {
                defaultUOM: _resolve('defaultUOM', 'ea'),
                defaultTaxCode: _resolve('defaultTaxCode', 'NON'),
                defaultWeightUOM: _resolve('defaultWeightUOM', 'kg'),
                defaultSizeUOM: _resolve('defaultSizeUOM', 'cm'),
                createAsInventory: _resolve('createAsInventory', true),
                createFinishedGoodsAsProducts: _resolve('createFinishedGoodsAsProducts', false),
                validatePartsExist: _resolve('validatePartsExist', true),
                processStagesSequentially: _resolve('processStagesSequentially', true),
                createBOMFromFilename: _resolve('createBOMFromFilename', false),
                autoCreateType: _resolve('autoCreateType', 'Build To Order')
            };

            _setVal('defaultUOM', s.defaultUOM);
            _setVal('defaultTaxCode', s.defaultTaxCode);
            _setVal('defaultWeightUOM', s.defaultWeightUOM);
            _setVal('defaultSizeUOM', s.defaultSizeUOM);
            _setChk('createAsInventory', s.createAsInventory !== false);
            _setChk('createFinishedGoodsAsProducts', s.createFinishedGoodsAsProducts);
            _setChk('validatePartsExist', s.validatePartsExist !== false);
            _setChk('processStagesSequentially', s.processStagesSequentially !== false);
            _setChk('createBOMFromFilename', s.createBOMFromFilename);
            _setVal('autoCreateType', s.autoCreateType);

            _applyToConfig(s);
            _setChk('showDebug', DEBUG_MODE);
            debugLog('success', 'Settings loaded from Fishbowl user account');
        }

        // Save combined configuration (settings + field mappings) to a portable file
        function saveConfiguration() {
            const configuration = {
                version: '1.0',
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                settings: _collectSettings(),
                fieldMappings: fieldMappings,
                levelConfig: levelConfig
            };

            const json = JSON.stringify(configuration, null, 2);
            const blob = new Blob([json], { type: 'application/json' });
            const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
            const a = document.createElement('a');
            a.href = url;
            a.download = `bom-converter-config-${new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0]}.json`;
            a.click();
            URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

            showMessage('Configuration saved successfully', 'success');
            debugLog('success', 'Configuration saved to file');
        }

        // Load combined configuration (settings + field mappings) from a file
        function loadConfiguration() {
            const input = document.createElement('input');
            input.type = 'file';
            input.accept = '.json';

            input.onchange = function(e) {
                const file = e.target.files[0];
                if (!file) return;

                const reader = new FileReader();
                reader.onload = function(event) {
                    try {
                        const configuration = JSON.parse(event.target.result);

                        // Load settings
                        if (configuration.settings) {
                            const settings = configuration.settings;
                            _setVal('defaultUOM', settings.defaultUOM);
                            _setVal('defaultTaxCode', settings.defaultTaxCode);
                            _setVal('defaultWeightUOM', settings.defaultWeightUOM);
                            _setVal('defaultSizeUOM', settings.defaultSizeUOM);
                            if (settings.createAsInventory !== undefined) _setChk('createAsInventory', settings.createAsInventory);
                            if (settings.createFinishedGoodsAsProducts !== undefined) _setChk('createFinishedGoodsAsProducts', settings.createFinishedGoodsAsProducts);
                            if (settings.validatePartsExist !== undefined) _setChk('validatePartsExist', settings.validatePartsExist);
                            if (settings.processStagesSequentially !== undefined) _setChk('processStagesSequentially', settings.processStagesSequentially);
                            if (settings.createBOMFromFilename !== undefined) _setChk('createBOMFromFilename', settings.createBOMFromFilename);
                            _setVal('autoCreateType', settings.autoCreateType);

                            // Persist to the Fishbowl user account + update in-memory config
                            persistSettings();
                        }

                        // Load the BOM level format
                        if (configuration.levelConfig && configuration.levelConfig.style) {
                            levelConfig = {
                                style: configuration.levelConfig.style,
                                endCol: configuration.levelConfig.endCol || null,
                                autoDetected: false
                            };
                        }

                        // Load field mappings
                        if (configuration.fieldMappings) {
                            fieldMappings = configuration.fieldMappings;
                            if (_settingsReady()) {
                                try {
                                    FBLib.Settings.setUserKey('fieldMappings', { mappings: fieldMappings, solidworksColumns: solidworksColumns, levelConfig: levelConfig, timestamp: new Date().toISOString() });
                                    FBLib.Settings.saveUser();
                                } catch (e) {}
                            }
                        }

                        showMessage('Configuration loaded successfully! Settings applied and field mappings ready.', 'success');
                        debugLog('success', 'Configuration loaded from file');

                        // Reprocess if we have data
                        if (rawCSVContent) {
                            processBOMData();
                        }
                    } catch (err) {
                        debugLog('error', 'Error loading configuration: ' + err.toString());
                        showMessage('Error loading configuration file: ' + err.message, 'danger');
                    }
                };
                reader.readAsText(file);
            };

            input.click();
        }

        // ============================================================
        // INIT
        // ============================================================
        (function init() {
            // User setting wins. FBLib.Settings.resolve('debug') returns the saved
            // user value if present, else the BI_SHOW_DEBUG property (propFallback),
            // else the default — so OVERWRITE (not OR) to honour a saved "off" even
            // when the property is on.
            DEBUG_MODE = !!_resolve('debug', DEBUG_MODE);
            var dc = document.getElementById('debugConsole');
            if (dc) dc.style.display = DEBUG_MODE ? 'block' : 'none';
            _setChk('showDebug', DEBUG_MODE);

            // Hydrate the settings controls + in-memory config from the user's saved settings.
            try { hydrateSettings(); } catch (e) {}
            try { PageSettings.init(); } catch (e) {}

            console.log('Solidworks BOM Conversion Tool initialized');
            debugLog('info', 'Solidworks BOM Conversion Tool initialized');
            debugLog('info', 'Upload Solidworks CSV to begin BOM conversion');

            if (typeof runQuery !== 'function' && typeof runQueryAsync !== 'function') {
                debugLog('warning', 'Not running inside Fishbowl — CSV export works, but validation and direct import are disabled.');
            }
        })();
    </script>
